project: Wuxia Life P106 Merchant Martial Patron Pressure Playable Implementation
description: Implement the patron pressure stage (护商武力负担) for merchant_martial_patron — runtime event wiring, expression updates, payoff gate adjustment, targeted proof, and regression tests. Strictly follows P105 pressure contract.

userStories.title: Wire patron pressure spine event
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the patron pressure event wired through the existing event system so players on the patron route encounter a real pressure milestone between on-ramp and payoff echo.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure merchant_patron_midlife_pressure choice event in sample-lines-spine.json
Trigger conditions: merchant_patron_on_ramp_done + age 40-44 + exclusivity guards
6 variant branches + generic fallback each set merchant_patron_midlife_pressure_done + merchant_patron_pressure_* marker
Event inserted between merchant_patron_bridge_entry and merchant_patron_payoff_echo
No new event framework or scheduler
P102-P104 existing evidence does not regress
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add pressure player-facing expression (core P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want the patron pressure to read as a meaningful turning point so the route feels like martial backer burden, not generic midlife stress.
acceptanceCriteria: deriveSampleLineCostLabel: on-ramp to pressure deepening per contract section 4.1 (6 variants)
merchantCurrentGoal: on-ramp state to pressure state per contract section 4.1 (6 variants)
Expression priority: magnate win > payoff > pressure > on-ramp; native > bridge-origin
At least 2 pressure-specific readable signals (cost label + current goal)
Preserve merchant-martial patron flavor; distinct from magnate/renown pressure text
No new UI components
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Adjust payoff gate and reserve flag interfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want payoff gate aligned with pressure checkpoint and downstream flag interfaces reserved so P107+ can build without renaming.
acceptanceCriteria: merchant_patron_payoff_echo gate requires merchant_patron_midlife_pressure_done + !merchant_patron_payoff_done
merchant_patron_payoff_resolved and merchant_patron_late_life_done placeholders visible in code
No payoff choice logic implemented in this stage
Pressure does not set merchant_patron_payoff_done or merchant_patron_identity_done
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add targeted pressure proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing patron pressure fires correctly on native + at least one bridge-origin path.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce 1 targeted proof (on-ramp to pressure path verification)
Show 5 core nodes: pre-pressure state, event fires, checkpoint set, cost label update, current goal update
At least 2 paths: native + 1 bridge-origin
No full lifetime exhaust required
Save as docs/test-reports/p106-merchant-martial-patron-pressure-targeted-proof.md
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the patron pressure stage so future edits do not break the first patron pressure milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: New test file covering pressure stage (e.g. p106MerchantMartialPatronPressureTests.ts)
Group 1: Event wiring (7 tests)
Group 2: Pre-pressure expression (2 tests)
Group 3: Post-pressure expression (4 P0 + 1 P1 tests)
Group 4: Distinct from magnate/renown (2 tests)
Group 5: No regression P102-P104 (3 tests)
Group 6: No regression P97-P101 magnate (2 tests)
About 19-22 assertions; reuse existing test harness; relevant commands pass
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Produce P106 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what the patron pressure stage now provides and whether payoff deepening is justified next.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p106-merchant-martial-patron-pressure-closure-report.md
Summarize event wiring, expression, payoff gate, proof, tests
Clarify boundary with P107+
List remaining deferred larger patron-expansion items
All 11 closure criteria from validation shape section 4.1 satisfied or defer noted
State GO or NO-GO for subsequent payoff stage
npm run typecheck passes
